claims.claim_text: Iridium operates a satellite network with an architecture of 66 operational satellites with in-orbit spares, using an interlinked mesh LEO L-band constellation. Operational, not just announced.
claims.extract_rubric: HIGH - constellation-operational vs constellation-announced. Stage ladder critical per Heuristic 3 and 9.

claims.claim_text: The U.S. government generated $257.0 million in revenue (29% of total) in FY2025, primarily under the Enhanced Mobile Satellite Services (EMSS) fixed-price contract signed in September 2019 with a total value of $738.5 million over seven years (annual fixed rate $110.5M). Contract ends September 2026.
claims.extract_rubric: HIGH - federal contract dollar + named program (EMSS) - USAspending verifiable. Layer 3 Rule 7 absence is hard contradiction.

claims.claim_text: Iridium is a subcontractor to General Dynamics Mission Systems under a Space Development Agency (SDA) contract awarded in May 2022, building ground entry points and operations centers for the DoW's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA).
claims.extract_rubric: HIGH - federal program (SDA PWSA) + named prime. Counterparty-disclosure threshold heuristic 7.

claims.claim_text: Iridium had approximately 2,537,000 billable subscribers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, a 3% increase YoY, with total revenue of $871.7M in 2025 (up from $830.7M in 2024).
claims.extract_rubric: HIGH - operational scale claim - mature commercial customer base test.

claims.claim_text: Iridium is developing 'Iridium NTN Direct' a 3GPP standards-based service (3GPP Release 19 accepted), expected to commercially launch from the existing constellation in 2026 for NB-IoT and direct-to-device (D2D) connectivity.
claims.extract_rubric: HIGH - direct-to-mobile claim. Stage ladder test (test-call vs MVNO vs commercial-service-live).

claims.claim_text: Iridium owns/leases several US satellite teleport facilities including Tempe AZ (System Gateway, owned building on leased land, 31,000 sf), Chandler AZ (197,000 sf technical support center & teleport), Leesburg VA (Satellite Network Operations Center, 40,000 sf owned), and Fairbanks AK (Satellite Teleport Facility, owned).
claims.extract_rubric: HIGH - EPA FRS scope. Telecom teleports / gateway facilities may register; absence of facility in FRS for satcom is not necessarily a red flag (no propulsion / chemicals).

claims.claim_text: Aireon LLC has hosted payloads on Iridium satellites for aircraft tracking services. Aireon revenue is recognized as hosted-payload revenue (fees for hosting + transmitting data).
claims.extract_rubric: MID - hosted-payload partnership, real but disclosure-only via Aireon's partial-owner relationship.

claims.claim_text: Iridium holds $1.8B of indebtedness under Term Loan (matures September 2030, SOFR+2.25%), with $96.5M cash. Paid $62.9M dividends in 2025 and repurchased $185.0M of stock; paused buybacks Oct 2025 for financial flexibility. Quarterly dividend $0.15/share.
claims.extract_rubric: MID - financial-distress check. Mature company with ~2x debt/EBITDA, well within covenants. Not distress.
